newsitem.title: USA: Mobile Gas authorized share hike cleared.
newsitem.headline: Mobile Gas authorized share hike cleared.

text.p: Mobile Gas Service Corp said that during Friday's annual meeting stockholders approved a proposed amendment to its restated articles of incorporation to double the authorized number of shares of common stock from four million to eight million and to reduce the par value of such common stock from $2.50 per share to $0.01 per share.
Mobile Gas Service is a local distribution company providing natural gas service to over 100,000 customers in southwest Alabama.
